title: Fabric material looks like knitted wool on small cosmetic parts
observation: A captain's coat, breeches and other clothing built from character-sized parts with Enum.Material.Fabric read in a Studio screenshot as a noisy dark knitted-wool texture that hid the colour and clashed with a clean toy-like art style. The same parts in SmoothPlastic read as clean, saturated colour blocks; large Fabric surfaces such as sails still looked fine.
recommendation: For a clean or toy-like style, build small cloth pieces (costume parts, pet accessories) in SmoothPlastic and keep Fabric for large cloth like sails and flags; check new materials in a screenshot at the distance players see them.
applies_when: Building avatar cosmetics or accessories from parts
Choosing materials for small cloth-like props
limits: One place's lighting and colour grade in October 2026
Graphics quality settings and phones were not compared

evidence.detail: Section 8 and the before-fabric screenshot: the first outfit pass in Fabric against the SmoothPlastic version.
